```{r}
### LOAD IN PACKAGES

library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(coda)
library(modelbased)
library(colorspace)
library(brms)
library(ggpubr)
library(bayesplot)
library(rlang)
library(stringr)
```

```{r}
### LOAD IN DATA
load('~/Analysis/Inter_Regression_fits_Revision.RData')

wC_ahR_predict <- read.csv('~/Analysis/wC_ahR_predict.csv')

w_ah_post <- read.csv("~/Analysis/w_ah_post.csv")

forage_og <- read.csv("~/FoRAGE_V5_sources_and_meta_inter.csv")
```

////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// Plotting wC/ahR Values ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

```{r}
# Rank C/R by study
study_names <- forage_og %>%
  select(Inter_ID, Source_Clean) %>%
  distinct()

forage_fits_abun_plot <- forage_fits_abun %>%
  left_join(study_names, by = "Inter_ID") %>%
  arrange(log_C_R_50) %>%
  mutate(
    Source_ord = factor(Source_Clean, levels = Source_Clean)
  )

```

```{r}
#add NAs for stuidies that do not have masses in FoRAGE
forage_fits_abun_plot <- forage_fits_abun_plot %>%
  mutate(
    log_wC_ahR_50 = ifelse(Inter_ID %in% c(14, 25), NA, log_wC_ahR_50),
    log_wC_ahR_25 = ifelse(Inter_ID %in% c(14, 25), NA, log_wC_ahR_25),
    log_wC_ahR_75 = ifelse(Inter_ID %in% c(14, 25), NA, log_wC_ahR_75),
    log_wC_ahR_5  = ifelse(Inter_ID %in% c(14, 25), NA, log_wC_ahR_5),
    log_wC_ahR_95 = ifelse(Inter_ID %in% c(14, 25), NA, log_wC_ahR_95)
  )
```

```{r}
# Find last study with log(C/R) < 0
crossover_index <- max(
  which(!is.na(forage_fits_abun_plot$log_C_R_50) &
        forage_fits_abun_plot$log_C_R_50 < 0)
)

crossover_y <- crossover_index + 0.5
```

```{r}
#Set x lims for wC/ahR plot
xlims_wC_ahR <- c(-11, 12)
```

```{r}
#Make forest Plot
wC_ahR_rank_plot <- ggplot(forage_fits_abun_plot,
       aes(y = Source_ord, x = log_wC_ahR_50)) +

  # 10–90% CI
  geom_segment(aes(
    x = log_wC_ahR_5,
    xend = log_wC_ahR_95,
    yend = Source_ord
  ),
  linewidth = 0.8,
  alpha = 0.6) +

  # 25–75% CI rectangle
  geom_rect(aes(
    ymin = as.numeric(Source_ord) - 0.35,
    ymax = as.numeric(Source_ord) + 0.35,
    xmin = log_wC_ahR_25,
    xmax = log_wC_ahR_75,
    fill = Pred_group_1
  ),
  #fill = "darkgrey",
  alpha = 0.8,
  inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
  values = c(
    "Insect" = "#1b9e77",
    "Crustacean" = "#7570b3",
    "Fish" = "#d95f02",
    "Arachnid" = "#e7298a"
  ),
  name = "Predator taxon"
) +

  # Median
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +

  # Vertical reference: wC/ahR = 1
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, linewidth = 2, alpha = 0.8) +

  # Horizontal crossover line: C/R = 1
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = crossover_y,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 2,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +

  labs(
    #y = "Studies Ranked by Median log(C/R)",
    y= NULL,
    x = "ln(wC/ahR)"
    
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = xlims_wC_ahR) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = NULL) +
  theme_cowplot(font_size = 40)

```

```{r}
wC_ahR_rank_plot <- wC_ahR_rank_plot +
  theme(
    axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank()
  )

wC_ahR_rank_plot <- wC_ahR_rank_plot +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 5,
      r = 5,
      b = 5,
      l = 0
    )
  )
```


```{r}
#summary data from Forest plot

summary_IQR_wC_ahR <- forage_fits_abun_plot %>%
  summarise(
    n_studies = n(),

    n_median_greater_0 = sum(log_wC_ahR_50 > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_50CI_no_overlap_0 = sum(log_wC_ahR_25 > 0 & log_wC_ahR_75 > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_90CI_no_overlap_0 = sum(log_wC_ahR_5 > 0 & log_wC_ahR_95 > 0, na.rm = TRUE),

    percent_median_greater_0 =
      100 * mean(log_wC_ahR_50 > 0, na.rm = TRUE),

    percent_50CI_no_overlap_0 =
      100 * mean(log_wC_ahR_25 > 0 & log_wC_ahR_75 > 0, na.rm = TRUE),

    percent_90CI_no_overlap_0 =
      100 * mean(log_wC_ahR_5 > 0 & log_wC_ahR_95 > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

```

////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// Plotting w/ah Values ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

```{r}
Inter_ID <- w_ah_post[, 1]
w_ah_draws <- w_ah_post[, -1]   # rows = studies, cols = iterations

```

```{r}
forage_fits_wah <- data.frame(
  Inter_ID = Inter_ID,
  log_w_ah_5 = apply(log(w_ah_draws), 1, quantile, probs = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
  log_w_ah_25 = apply(log(w_ah_draws), 1, quantile, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
  log_w_ah_50 = apply(log(w_ah_draws), 1, quantile, probs = 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
  log_w_ah_75 = apply(log(w_ah_draws), 1, quantile, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
  log_w_ah_95 = apply(log(w_ah_draws), 1, quantile, probs = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
)

```


```{r}
forage_fits_wah_CR <- forage_fits_wah %>%
  left_join(
    forage_fits_abun %>% 
      select(Inter_ID, log_C_R_50, Pred_group_1),
    by = "Inter_ID"
  )

```

```{r}

forage_fits_wah_plot <- forage_fits_wah_CR %>%
  filter(!Inter_ID %in% c(15, 38)) %>%
  left_join(study_names, by = "Inter_ID") %>%
  arrange(log_C_R_50) %>%
  mutate(
    Source_ord = factor(
      paste0(Source_Clean, "_", row_number()),
      levels = paste0(Source_Clean, "_", row_number())
    )
  )

```

```{r}
crossover_index <- max(
  which(forage_fits_wah_plot$log_C_R_50 < 0)
)

crossover_y <- crossover_index + 0.5
```

```{r}
#Set x lims for w/ah plot
xlims_wah <- c(-5.2, 13.5)
```

```{r}
w_ah_rank_plot <- ggplot(
  forage_fits_wah_plot,
  aes(y = Source_ord, x = log_w_ah_50)
) +

  geom_segment(aes(
    x = log_w_ah_5,
    xend = log_w_ah_95,
    yend = Source_ord
  ),
  linewidth = 0.8,
  alpha = 0.6) +

  geom_rect(aes(
    ymin = as.numeric(Source_ord) - 0.35,
    ymax = as.numeric(Source_ord) + 0.35,
    xmin = log_w_ah_25,
    xmax = log_w_ah_75,
    fill = Pred_group_1
  ),
  #fill = "darkgrey",
  alpha = 0.8,
  inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
  values = c(
    "Insect" = "#1b9e77",
    "Crustacean" = "#7570b3",
    "Fish" = "#d95f02",
    "Arachnid" = "#e7298a"),
  name = "Predator taxon") +

  geom_point(size = 2.5) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, linewidth = 2, alpha = 0.8) +

  geom_hline(
    yintercept = crossover_y,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 2,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = forage_fits_wah_plot$Source_Clean
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = xlims_wah,
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +

  labs(
    y = "Studies Ranked by Median ln(C/R)",
    x = "ln(w/ah)"
  ) +
  theme_cowplot(font_size = 40) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20))

```




```{r}
summary_IQR_w_ah <- forage_fits_wah_plot %>%
  summarise(
    n_studies = n(),

    # Medians
    n_median_greater_0 = sum(log_w_ah_50 > 0),
    percent_median_greater_0 = 100 * mean(log_w_ah_50 > 0),

    # 50% credible interval (IQR)
    n_50CI_no_overlap_0 = sum(log_w_ah_25 > 0 & log_w_ah_75 > 0),
    percent_50CI_no_overlap_0 = 100 * mean(log_w_ah_25 > 0 & log_w_ah_75 > 0),

    # 80% credible interval (10–90%)
    n_90CI_no_overlap_0 = sum(log_w_ah_5 > 0 & log_w_ah_95 > 0),
    percent_90CI_no_overlap_0 = 100 * mean(log_w_ah_5 > 0 & log_w_ah_95 > 0)
  )

```

```{r}
taxa_boxplot_wCahR <- ggplot(
  forage_fits_abun_plot,
  aes(
    x = Pred_group_1,
    y = log_wC_ahR_50,
    fill = Pred_group_1
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = Pred_group_1),
    width = 0.15,
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Insect" = "#1b9e77",
      "Crustacean" = "#7570b3",
      "Fish" = "#d95f02",
      "Arachnid" = "#e7298a"
    ),
    name = "Predator taxon"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Insect" = "#1b9e77",
      "Crustacean" = "#7570b3",
      "Fish" = "#d95f02",
      "Arachnid" = "#e7298a"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  theme_cowplot()
  
```
